title: Michael Johnson's visit and matching drawings
summary: Mario Woods tells of Michael Johnson's visit and matching drawings, about 1977 at Hanes Way Apartments, Rapid City, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Hanes Way Apartments, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: everything he saw the craft he saw the black sphere in front of the vehicle jumping up and down he smelled the smell he heard do not fear he heard all that and saw every bit of it
Let's do something here, man. I saw something. I want to write it down before I forget.
tellings.difference: Told by Michael himself, firsthand, rather than by Mario; it stresses that he wanted to write it down before forgetting.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Michael's visit to Mario's home in Rapid City, where Michael drew what he saw. This telling gives Michael's side of the visit that Mario describes.

as_told.title: Michael draws the alien at Mario's home before leaving

plain: Mario Woods, a former Air Force guard at a nuclear weapons base who says he was abducted, tells how in 1977 a fellow airman, Michael Johnson, came to his apartment at Hanes Way Apartments in Rapid City, South Dakota. Woods says Johnson described everything he himself had experienced: the craft, a black sphere bouncing in front of their vehicle, a strange smell, and a voice saying "do not fear", and that their drawings of the craft matched. Johnson, telling it himself, says he told Woods he had seen something and wanted to write it down before he forgot. If true, two men would have recalled the same encounter independently.
